the levels of NQO1 and GSTa1 were decreased in SAMP 8 mice at 10 months of age.
the nuclear translocation and the phosphorylation of GSK- 3β were decreased in the livers of S AMP8 mice.
the nuclear translocation and expression level of Nrf-2 in the liver were decreased in SAMP 8 mice, resulting in a decrease of the expression of Nrf- 2 target genes, such as GSTa1 and HO-1.

the relationship between the Nrf2 signaling pathway and aging.
the relationship between the nuclear translocation Nrf2 and the phosphorylation of GSK-β, and provides new insights into the mechanisms of accelerated aging in SAMP8.
the relationship between the Nrf2 pathway, the Akt/GSK3β signaling pathway, and accelerated aging in SAMP8.

SAMP8 mice have a decrease in the level of Nrf-2 and its downstream signaling pathway, resulting in a higher level of systemic oxidative stress.

the Nrf2 signaling pathway is a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of age-related diseases.
